confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Cartagena price levels; no live listings or booking pages were checked and no web source was used for the price anchors. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel rates are least certain given July high season and wide variation by neighborhood. cocktail and wine_glass were not directly known and were set from the beer anchor using typical local markups. midrange_meal_2p assumes any tax and service charge on the bill. Peso volatility adds uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Regional basis: Colombian Caribbean-coast urban tourism pricing, with the Old City and Getsemani tourist districts as the reference for July high-season demand.
